emptyDescription: Add an object storage account. The SiYuan sync configuration can be imported on the data sources page.
imported: Imported the SiYuan S3 sync configuration
importMissing: SiYuan has no usable S3 sync configuration
siyuanImportHint: Bucket, region and credentials are read live from Settings → Sync on every query; the plugin stores none of them.
siyuanImportProviderHint: Detected from the endpoint by default; choose one if the guess is wrong.
siyuanImportRemoveConfirm: Remove “{name}”? You can import it again afterwards.
noBuckets: This data source has no bucket yet.
credentialUnreadable: Credentials cannot be decrypted. The data repo key may have changed; please enter them again.
encryptionUnavailable: Credentials cannot be saved because the data repo key is unavailable in this environment.
unsupported: Not provided by this provider, or no data yet
sourceRegionHint: For example cn-hangzhou, ap-guangzhou or auto
sourceHuaweiProjectIdHint: Copy it from the Huawei Cloud console: My Credentials → API Credentials → Projects. Traffic and requests are only queried when it is filled in.
sourceBucketsHint: One bucket per line; commas are also accepted
sourceBucketsRequired: Please fill in at least one bucket
sourceNoRepoKey: Cannot save credentials: initialize or import a data repo key in Settings → Data repo key first.
sourceNoWebCrypto: Cannot save credentials: this page is not a secure context. Open SiYuan on desktop or via 127.0.0.1.
sourceEncryptionReady: Manual credentials are encrypted with the SiYuan data repo key before being saved, and sync with the workspace.
sourceEncryptionDisabled: Manual credentials cannot be saved in this environment; use the SiYuan S3 sync configuration instead.
errorAuth: Authentication failed. Check the keys and permissions.
settingsNote: Only usage data is queried; billing APIs are not used. Provider data may be delayed.
noteOssDelay: OSS statistics are not real-time; the delay can exceed 1 hour.
noteCosDelay: COS monitoring data is delayed by about 2 hours.
noteObsDelay: OBS bucket storage is background statistics and may be delayed.
noteTosDelay: TOS statistics are not real-time; the delay can exceed 1 hour.
noteQiniuDelay: Qiniu statistics are delayed by about 5 minutes.
noteMinioRealtime: MinIO returns the last completed scanner snapshot, not a real-time value.
noteR2Range: R2 Analytics covers the last 31 days; the latest bucket snapshot is shown.
noteAwsDaily: CloudWatch publishes bucket size once per day.
noteR2Daily: Request count and traffic are totals for the last 24 hours.
noteAwsScope: Totals sum the main storage classes; overhead and staging filters are excluded.
noteMetricsWindow: Traffic and requests are totals for the last 24 hours, not billing figures.
noteMetricsFailed: Traffic and requests could not be queried (monitoring permission may be missing); storage and object counts are still shown.
noteObsProjectId: Traffic and requests need a project ID and region.
noteObsRate: Request count is integrated from the per-second average.
noteQiniuRequests: Requests are the sum of GET and PUT counts.
noteVolcDerived: Traffic and requests are integrated from average bandwidth/QPS and may differ from the console.
noteMinioCumulative: MinIO metrics are cumulative since the server started, not a 24-hour window.
noteAwsRequestMetrics: Enable CloudWatch request metrics on the bucket to see traffic and requests; CloudWatch only lists metrics that received data in the last two weeks.
noteAwsMultiFilter: Several CloudWatch request-metric filters exist for this bucket; the totals add all of them, so overlapping ranges may be counted twice.
queryTimeoutHint: 5–300 seconds; increase it for slow provider monitoring APIs.
checkTimeoutHint: Longest wait per bucket, 5 seconds by default; timeouts usually mean a wrong endpoint or no network.
autoRefreshHint: Only while this dialog is open.
clearCredentialsConfirm: Clear the saved Access Key / Secret Key for “{name}”? You must enter them again before querying, and unsaved edits in this form will be lost.
